s.n: Vince's double cheese sliders with fries
s.note: Double beef, American cheese, onion, skinny fries.
s.how: Fry the potatoes at 160C until soft, drain, then fry again at 190C until crisp and salt them. Roll the mince into 16 small balls, smash thin on a hot griddle and season. Flip, top half the patties with cheese and stack a plain one on each. Build in the toasted buns with onion, pickle, sauce and mustard and serve with the fries.

s.n: Cha Cha Cha jerk chicken skewers with mango
s.note: Allspice and chilli chicken, grilled mango, lime. Mia's pick: the place with little red candles.
s.how: Blend the spring onions, chilli, garlic, allspice, thyme, soy, sugar and the juice of a lime to a paste. Toss the chicken in the paste and leave for at least 10 minutes, or overnight. Thread the chicken and mango onto the skewers. Grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through, and serve with lime wedges.

m.n: Toretto's tuna on white, no crust
m.note: Tuna, celery, dill pickle, lemon mayo, iceberg. Brian orders it every single day.
m.how: Flake the tuna into a bowl and mix with the celery, pickle, mayonnaise, dill, a little lemon zest and juice, salt and lots of pepper. Spread the tuna thickly over 4 slices of bread, add a lettuce leaf and close with the other slices. Press down gently, cut the crusts off with a sharp knife, then cut each sandwich in half.
shop: 2 x 185g tins tuna in olive oil, drained@Seafood

m.note: Mojo pork, ham, Swiss, pickles, mustard, pressed. Dom lives life a quarter mile at a time.
m.how: Mix the orange and lime juice with the garlic, cumin, oregano and 2 teaspoons of salt and rub it over the pork. Roast covered at 160C until tender, then uncover for the last 20 minutes to brown, and rest. Slice the pork thinly, split the rolls and spread with mustard. Layer the ham, pork, cheese and pickles, butter the outsides and press in a hot pan under a heavy pan, turning once, until crisp and melting. Cut on the diagonal and serve.

w.note: Cinnamon sugar churros, thick spiced chocolate.
w.how: Bring the water, butter and a tablespoon of sugar to the boil, tip in the flour and beat until it forms a ball, then cool for 5 minutes. Beat in the eggs one at a time and spoon the dough into a piping bag with a star nozzle. Warm the milk, stir in the chocolate, half the cinnamon and the chilli until thick and smooth. Pipe 12cm lengths into oil at 180C and fry until golden, a few at a time. Roll the hot churros in the 80g sugar mixed with the rest of the cinnamon and serve with the chocolate.
shop: 1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 80g for coating@Pantry

d.n: Corona with a wedge of lime
d.note: Ice cold, straight from the backyard tub. Any brew you want, as long as it's a Corona.
d.how: Bury the bottles in a tub of ice for an hour. Open, push a lime wedge into each neck and hand them round.
